suspects.description: Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `lp_pixel_format` self-updates via the address of ONE sibling scalar field whose byte offset equals the array element stride (e.g. `(T *)&lp_pixel_format->owner`). Replace `lp_pixel_format->some_array[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.

Watcom inline memcpy (REP MOVSD at 10002b79, 4-byte stride). Ghidra reconstructs this as a countdown for-loop with element-by-element copies; replace the loop with memcpy(dst, src, count * 4) or a struct assignment in a .keep.
